questions.question: Not ______ what to say, he remained silent during the meeting.
questions.explanation: 분사구문(부정: Not + -ing). 주어와 능동 관계 → 현재분사.

questions.question: The proposal is expected ______ by the committee before the deadline.
questions.explanation: be expected to be p.p. → 수동 의미의 to부정사.

questions.question: I would appreciate ______ informed of any changes in advance.
questions.explanation: appreciate는 동명사 목적어, 수동 → being p.p.

questions.question: The problem turned out ______ more complicated than we had anticipated.
All things ______, the project was a success.
questions.explanation: 독립분사구문 (All things considered = 모든 것을 고려하면).

questions.question: She had difficulty ______ herself understood in English.
questions.explanation: have difficulty -ing. 구조: make + 목적어 + p.p.

questions.question: He seems ______ the truth, judging from his reaction.
The manager insisted that the report ______ before noon.
questions.explanation: insist that + 주어 + (should) 동사원형 → 수동이면 be p.p.

questions.question: There is no point ______ about things you cannot change.
He was busy ______ ready for the presentation when I called him.
